data.title: Operating and heating cost statement 2025 – €184.30 to pay
data.summary: Wohnbau Musterstadt eG sent the operating and heating cost statement for 2025 (your period of use 1 October–31 December 2025). It shows an additional payment of €184.30, due by 9 October 2026, and raises your prepayments from 1 November 2026.
data.explanation: Your landlord has calculated your share of the building's running costs for 2025. Your costs were €544.30 and you prepaid €360.00, so you owe €184.30. Pay it by 9 October 2026 to the account given, using the stated reference. From 1 November 2026 your monthly total rent rises from €640 to €670 because the prepayments go up. Update your standing order unless you use direct debit. You may raise objections (Einwendungen) within twelve months after receiving the statement, and you can inspect the receipts by appointment. If unsure about the figures, consider asking a tenants' association for advice.
data.tax_note: Operating and heating cost statements can matter for household-related services claims (e.g. tradesman or cleaning services) in your tax return.
